approved: Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015

The member for Paterson supported the Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015, noting that Paterson has the fourth-highest number of residents over 70 in Australia, with 18,642 people aged over 70 making up 15.6 per cent of the electorate's population.

The Aged Care Amendment (Independent Complaints Arrangements) Bill 2015 transfers aged-care complaints handling from the Department of Social Services to the Aged Care Complaints Commissioner from 1 January 2016, implementing recommendations from the 2009 Walton review and the Productivity Commission's 2011 report.
